# truenas_certificate (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS certificate by name (certificate.create requires name to be unique).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `add_to_trusted_store` (Boolean) Whether this certificate is added to the trusted certificate store.
- `cert_type` (String) Human-readable certificate type.
- `certificate` (String) PEM-encoded certificate, or null.
- `certificate_path` (String) Filesystem path to the certificate file, or null.
- `city` (String) City from the certificate subject, or null.
- `common` (String) Common name from the certificate subject, or null.
- `country` (String) Country from the certificate subject, or null.
- `csr` (String) PEM-encoded certificate signing request, or null.
- `csr_path` (String) Filesystem path to the CSR file, or null.
- `ec_curve` (String) Elliptic curve, if applicable (not echoed back by the API, so always null via this datasource).
- `email` (String) Email from the certificate subject, or null.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the certificate has expired, or null.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint, or null.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the certificate.
- `key_length` (Number) Key length in bits, or null.
- `key_type` (String) Cryptographic key algorithm, or null.
- `organization` (String) Organization from the certificate subject, or null.
- `organizational_unit` (String) Organizational unit from the certificate subject, or null.
- `privatekey` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded private key, or null.
- `privatekey_path` (String) Filesystem path to the private key file, or null.
- `renew_days` (Number) Days before expiration to attempt renewal.
- `root_path` (String) Filesystem directory where certificate-related files are stored.
- `san` (List of String) Subject alternative names.
- `state` (String) State from the certificate subject, or null.
